CCD Antithrombotic Therapy and Monitoring (2023 AHA/ACC CCD Guideline §4.3.1)

version 1.0 · Antonio Zaitoun — PROforma CIG for antiplatelet and oral anticoagulant therapy in adults with chronic coronary disease, from section 4.3.1 of the 2023 AHA/ACC chronic coronary disease guideline and the US prescribing information of its drugs. It collects the patient data the regimen choice depends on, recommends an antithrombotic regimen and a P2Y12 inhibitor, delivers the drugs with NSAID avoidance and gastroprotection, and monitors completion of the recommendations, the desired reduction of ischemic events and the adverse drug effects, with a test step or a further-examination alert after each adverse-effect enquiry. The task set is the one fixed by the approved proposal.
